out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF BLEACH SANITIZER STORED ON SHELF NEAR COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH CHEMICAL NAME.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO AIR GAP FOR SANITIZER BASIN PIPING AND FLOOR DRAIN. OBSERVED PIPE DIRECTLY INSIDE AND BELOW FLOOD RIM LEVEL OF DRAIN.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CFM CONTACTED PLUMBER TO ADDRESS ISSUE. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITHIN 3 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GAPS IN PIPING ENTERING/EXITING WALLS UNDERNEATH 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Seal all gaps in walls, ceilings, floors.
